apps.name: Manic EMU v2.0.1
apps.subtitle: Love Retro Games
apps.localizedDescription:
Manic EMU is an all-in-one retro emulator for iPhone and iPad. Console, handheld, arcade, computer, and mobile classics live in one library. The app does not include games, BIOS, or game data. Use only legally owned backups, homebrew, or public-domain software.

Supported Platforms

Nintendo
- Nintendo 3DS (3DS)
- Nintendo GameCube (NGC)
- Nintendo Wii (Wii)
- Nintendo 64 (N64)
- Nintendo DS (NDS)
- Game Boy Advance (GBA)
- Game Boy Color (GBC)
- Game Boy (GB)
- Nintendo Entertainment System (NES)
- Famicom Disk System (FDS)
- Super Nintendo Entertainment System (SNES)
- Virtual Boy (VB)
- Pokemon Mini (PM)

Sony
- PlayStation (PS1)
- PlayStation Portable (PSP)

Sega
- Dreamcast (DC)
- Sega Saturn (SS)
- Sega Master System (MS)
- Game Gear (GG)
- SG-1000 (SG)
- Sega Genesis 32X (32X)
- Sega CD / Mega-CD (MCD)
- Sega Genesis / Mega Drive (MD)

NEC
- PC Engine (PCE)
- TurboGrafx-16 (TG-16)
- TurboGrafx-CD (TG-CD)
- SuperGrafx (SGX)

SNK
- Neo Geo Pocket (NGP)
- Neo Geo Pocket Color (NGPC)

Atari
- Atari 2600
- Atari 5200
- Atari 7800
- Atari Jaguar
- Atari Lynx

Commodore
- Commodore 64 (C64)
- Amiga

Other
- Arcade
- DOOM
- MS-DOS
- Java ME (J2ME)
- Symbian

More systems are planned.

[RetroAchievements]
- Challenge players worldwide and light up trophies that are yours
- Multiset: grind multiple sets on one game — earn subset trophies without patching
- Hardcore Mode: tougher rules, trophies that actually count

[Save States, Your Way]
- Unlimited manual save states plus 50 auto slots
- Save Manager: browse by time, compare, and restore in one tap

[Speed, Cheats & Shortcuts]
- 5x fast forward — you set the pace
- Cheats on demand from an online library
- Custom shortcuts for save, speed, and screenshots

[Filters, Skins & Screenshots]
- Retro filters from our exclusive library
- Skins that feel like real hardware, third-party skins welcome, flex layouts that fit your hands
- Screenshots for the highlight reel

[Landscape Library]
- Landscape console mode — library, covers, and shortcuts on one screen
- Background music and navigation sounds — browsing feels like an arcade
- Browse with a controller or keyboard — stay on the couch

[Play Together]
- Local multiplayer whenever you want
- Eligible cores can host rooms, scan LAN, connect over relay, and spectate

[Cloud Import in One Step]
- Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Baidu Cloud, Aliyun
- WebDAV and SMB too — bring the whole library over in one go

[Controllers Your Way]
- Native Joy-Con, DualShock, and Xbox support
- Bluetooth controllers and keyboards — play on Mac too
- Multiple controllers at once, solo or a full party

[AirPlay — Living Room Ready]
- AirPlay to a TV or display
- Phone to TV without a hitch — couch nights and hangouts
- Big screen plus a controller — immersion maxed out

versions.localizedDescription:
- Added WonderSwan support
- Added NAOMI, Atomiswave, and System SP arcade support
- Added Flash support
  · Skin button binding
  · Hardware keyboard input
  · Software keyboard input
  · Touch input
- Built-in, self-contained JIT — no external debugger required
- Added Slow Motion
- Improved GameCube and Wii performance
- GameCube now supports multi-disc games
- Improved Wii motion controls
- Simulate the Wii IR pointer by touch
- Add games from other emulators via a link
- Fixed some arcade systems that wouldn’t run
- Fixed Dreamcast games running too fast
- Fixed PSP crashes
- Added NDS lid open/close
- Improved rotation: with orientation lock on in Control Center, the app no longer snaps back to portrait
- In-game shortcut tips can now be turned off
- Landscape library can disable carousel style
- Smoother landscape carousel scrolling
- MultiDisc Helper supports more formats
- Hardware keyboard input for Symbian, Amiga, and C64
- Added RomM support
  · LAN self-hosted servers only
  · Sync only for games imported from RomM
  · Manual sync only, from the service card’s long-press menu
  · Pull ROMs, covers, metadata, manuals, and game saves
- Fixed a launch timeout that could quit the app on older devices
- N64 now supports ROMs larger than 64 MB

apps.name: YTKace
apps.versionDescription:
by @itzzace0

What's new:
• Updated to YouTube 21.37.5
• Queue videos without Premium — play next, play last, reorder, shuffle, loop and clear
• Playlist downloads — grab every video or pick the ones you want
• YouTube's Download button can now open the YTKACE menu
• Choose where the download button lives: player overlay, YouTube's button, or both
• Save downloads to the share sheet, with separate video and audio destinations
• Hide the products shelf
• iOS 15 support for the tweak packages

Fixed:
• 2K and 4K missing from the download quality list
• Shorts Save button not removed unless YouTube was in English
• Community posts breaking with Block Premium Prompts on
• Action bar disappearing while scrolling the feed
• Settings unreachable if both the YTKACE and Library tabs were removed
• YTKACE settings opening another tweak's settings when both were installed

YouTube 21.37.5 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs:
• `YTKACE_1.0.0_YouTube_21.37.5.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer
• `YTKACE_1.0.0_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16
apps.localizedDescription: YTKace – a modified YouTube client with extra features. This build requires iOS 17 or newer.
apps.subtitle: Enhanced YouTube for iOS 17 and newer
